from common import *
import copy,gzip

def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    check(read(PROGRESS)['prepared_inputs'])
    variant=sys.argv[1];assert variant in VARIANTS
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
    from qlib.data import D
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    frozen_st=PROVIDER.parent/'st_daily.csv'
    regime=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5/configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv'
    cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'))
    inputs=BASE/'docs/evaluation-inputs.json';cache=TMP/'official-evaluation-inputs.pkl'
    if cache.exists():
        r=read(inputs);check(r['cache']);check(r['st_daily']);check(r['regime']);saved=pd.read_pickle(cache)
    else:
        with gzip.open(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz','rt') as f:inventory=json.load(f)
        for r in inventory['files']:check(r)
        cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(D.calendar(start_time='2020-08-03',end_time='2026-07-31'))
        labels=ev.prepare_pool_labels('all','2020-08-03','2026-07-31',[5],{5:ev.label_window_cutoff(cal,5)},min_listing_days=60,st_daily=frozen_st,min_amount=1e7)
        tradable=ev.entry_tradable_mask('all','2020-08-03','2026-07-31')
        saved={'labels':labels,'tradable':tradable};pd.to_pickle(saved,cache)
        write(inputs,{'cache':fingerprint(cache),'st_daily':fingerprint(frozen_st),'regime':fingerprint(regime),'provider_inventory':fingerprint(PREVIOUS/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'),'cutoff':str(ev.label_window_cutoff(cal,5).date()),'source':'Canonical prepare_pool_labels and entry_tradable_mask; reused exactly across all arms'})
    # Preserve canonical evaluation math and schema; only replace repeated I/O with verified frozen signals/filters.
    ev.prepare_pool_labels=lambda *args,**kwargs:saved['labels']
    ev.entry_tradable_mask=lambda *args,**kwargs:saved['tradable']
    ev._build_dataset=lambda *args,**kwargs:None
    class Frozen:
        def __init__(self,pred):self.pred=pred
        def predict(self,dataset,segment='test'):return self.pred
    def evaluate(preds,sessions,tag):
        ev._load_model=lambda session:Frozen(preds[session])
        original_panel=ev.daily_head_panel;captured=[]
        def capture_panel(pred,label,ks,**kwargs):
            panels=original_panel(pred,label,sorted(set(ks)|{5}),**kwargs)
            captured.append({str(k):{str(d.date()):sorted(v) for d,v in panels[k]['sets'].items()} for k in [3,5]})
            return panels
        ev.daily_head_panel=capture_panel
        try:r=ev.evaluate_multi_horizon(cfg,sessions,['all'],horizons=[5],st_daily=frozen_st,min_listing_days=60,min_count=20,regime_monthly=ev.load_regime_monthly(regime),regime_pools=['all'],head_k=[3],exclude_limit_up=True,min_amount=1e7)
        finally:ev.daily_head_panel=original_panel
        assert len(captured)==6
        per_seed={str(seed):captured[i] for i,(_,seed) in enumerate(sessions)}
        overlaps={}
        for k in [3,5]:
            pair_values=[]
            for i in range(5):
                for j in range(i+1,5):
                    x,y=captured[i][str(k)],captured[j][str(k)]
                    assert set(x)==set(y)
                    pair_values.append(sum(len(set(x[d])&set(y[d]))/k for d in x)/len(x))
            overlaps[str(k)]={'mean_pairwise_overlap':float(np.mean(pair_values)),'min_pairwise_overlap':float(min(pair_values)),'pairs':10}
        proof=BASE/'data'/f'{tag}-formal-heads.json';write(proof,{'seeds':per_seed,'ensemble':captured[-1],'pairwise_agreement':overlaps,'source':'Canonical daily_head_panel; k5 diagnostic only, official metrics remain k3h5'})
        write(BASE/'data'/f'{tag}-ensemble-heads.json',captured[-1])
        r['diagnostic_seed_head_agreement']=overlaps;r['diagnostic_heads']=fingerprint(proof)
        assert r['data_version']=='2026-11-03' and r['label_window_cutoff']['h5']=='2026-07-23'
        assert r['pools']['all']['ensemble']['head']['3']['5']['n_days']==1448
        return r
    control_receipt=BASE/'docs/control-evaluation-verification.json'
    if control_receipt.exists():
        for r in read(control_receipt)['artifacts']:check(r)
    else:
        specs=[]
        for h in [7,15,20]:
            proof=read(PRIOR/'docs'/f'sources-h{h}.json')
            components=[{**c,'prediction':fingerprint(ROOT/f'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h{h}'/f'{c["session"]}_pred.pkl')} for c in proof['components']]
            specs.append((f'h{h}continuous',components,PRIOR/'metrics'/f'h{h}-model.json'))
        for name,treatment,reference in [('h20q10','new',PREVIOUS/'metrics/quantile10-new.json'),('v5','old',CURRENT/'metrics/model-evaluation.json')]:
            specs.append((name,read(PREVIOUS/'docs'/f'predictions-quantile10-{treatment}.json')['components'],reference))
        artifacts=[];proofs=[]
        for name,components,reference in specs:
            preds={};sessions=[]
            for c in components:
                check(c['model']);check(c['prediction']);p=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path'])
                preds[c['session']]=p.iloc[:,0] if isinstance(p,pd.DataFrame) else p;sessions.append((c['session'],c['seed']))
            assert [x[1] for x in sessions]==SEEDS
            actual=evaluate(preds,sessions,name);prior=read(reference)
            x=actual['pools']['all']['ensemble'];y=prior['pools']['all']['ensemble']
            for key in ['net_ann','net_ann_vol','net_sharpe','ann','turnover']:
                assert abs(x['head']['3']['5'][key]-y['head']['3']['5'][key])<1e-12,(name,key)
                for block in ['head_years','head_regimes']:
                    for label in y[block]:
                        assert abs(x[block][label]['3']['5'][key]-y[block][label]['3']['5'][key])<1e-12,(name,block,label,key)
            assert abs(x['h5']['rank_ic_mean']-y['h5']['rank_ic_mean'])<1e-12
            out=BASE/'metrics'/f'{name}.json';write(out,actual);artifacts.append(fingerprint(out))
            proofs.append({'name':name,'reference':fingerprint(reference),'components':components,'exact_metric_match':True})
            del preds
        write(control_receipt,{'controls':proofs,'artifacts':artifacts,'canonical_tolerance':1e-12,'same_source_H20':'h20continuous and h20q10 use Nov3 labels; v5 uses old-label source and is formal historical baseline only'})
    bundle=ROOT/'backtest/result/20261107_pathsum_quantile10';bundle.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not (bundle/'meta.json').exists():write(bundle/'meta.json',{'mode':'research_prediction_bundle','owner_experiment':EID,'note':'Path-sum and q10 horizon study; four five-seed signals','created_at':time.time()})
    jobs=[j for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'] if j['variant']==variant]
    for treatment in sorted({j['treatment'] for j in jobs},reverse=True):
        preds={};sessions=[];components=[]
        for j in sorted([j for j in jobs if j['treatment']==treatment],key=lambda j:SEEDS.index(j['seed'])):
            pieces=[]
            for year in range(2020,2027):
                item=next(v for v in read(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{variant}-{year}.json')['predictions'] if v['job_id']==j['job_id'])
                check(item['prediction_part']);pieces.append(pd.read_pickle(item['prediction_part']['path']))
            pred=pd.concat(pieces).sort_index();assert pred.index.is_unique and np.isfinite(pred.to_numpy()).all()
            if preds:assert pred.index.equals(next(iter(preds.values())).index)
            out=bundle/f'{variant}-{treatment}-s{j["seed"]}.pkl';pred.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
            r=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{j["job_id"]}.json');components.append({'seed':j['seed'],'session':j['session'],'model':r['model'],'prediction':fingerprint(out),'training':fingerprint(BASE/'docs'/f'{j["job_id"]}.json')});preds[j['session']]=pred;sessions.append((j['session'],j['seed']))
        assert [s for _,s in sessions]==SEEDS
        ensemble=blend_score_series(list(preds.values()));out=bundle/f'{variant}-{treatment}-ensemble.pkl';ensemble.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
        proof=BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-{variant}-{treatment}.json';write(proof,{'variant':variant,'treatment':treatment,'components':components,'ensemble':fingerprint(out)})
        result=evaluate(preds,sessions,f'{variant}-{treatment}')
        result['label_target_study']={'variant':variant,'horizon':HORIZONS[variant],'prediction_proof':fingerprint(proof),'formal_baseline':BASELINE_ID,'paired_control':'h20continuous/h20q10' if variant.startswith('sum') else f'h{HORIZONS[variant]}continuous','source_snapshot':'Nov3 raw labels; Nov2 features; Nov3 evaluation','sample_limitation':'Per explicit user correction, missing intermediate returns are skipped without count scaling on the unchanged H20 sample mask. Sum continuous/q10 and original H20 share exact ordered training rows. Unequal observed-term counts are audited; terminal H7/H15/H20 q10-vs-continuous pairs each preserve their original own mask.'}

        path=BASE/'metrics'/f'{variant}-{treatment}.json';write(path,result)
        progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['scientific_candidates'][variant]['treatments'][treatment]={'status':'completed','evaluation':fingerprint(path),'prediction_proof':fingerprint(proof)};write(PROGRESS,progress)
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['scientific_candidates'][variant]['status']='evaluated_awaiting_registration';write(PROGRESS,progress)
    print('canonical evaluation complete',variant,flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
